method: Historical URLs: Wayback Machine CDX API (url=upcoretech.com/*, every capture, assets filtered out; www.upcoretech.com/* returned the identical 1,618 URL keys), kept page-like URLs with a 200/301 text/html (or RSS for feeds) capture, normalized (lowercase, no query/fragment, no trailing slash) and dropped wp-admin/wp-json/wp-content/wp-includes/xmlrpc/wp-login/.well-known/attachment/?p= and non-page files -> 112 paths. Added every <loc> from all 18 archived copies of the old Yoast post-sitemap.xml and page-sitemap.xml (2024-06..2026-01) -> 285 paths, plus 38 tag/category/feed/pagination/service URLs linked from the archived pages -> 323 paths checked. Each was requested live on https://www.upcoretech.com (HEAD, re-confirmed with GET on any 4xx/5xx; redirects followed; 4 workers, 20s timeout) on 2026-10-28; 274 end in 404 (none 410). Each 404 was mapped to the most relevant current page per audit issue #1, with destinations verified live 200. Posts with no genuinely relevant current page are listed under leave_404 (redirecting them would be a soft 404); fallback_if_backlinks names the least-bad target if backlink data later justifies a redirect. Exact sources are used for /services/* and /insights/<slug>; pattern rules only for /case-studies, /category, /tag, /insights/page/N and per-post feeds. Sources were compiled with path-to-regexp 6.1.0 using the options Vercel uses (strict, case-sensitive) and checked against every current page (sitemap + repo HTML), every planned path in tools/content/backlog.json and the existing vercel.json redirects (simulated in order with these rules appended after them; the host-conditional /:path* rule for upcore-ai-workforces.vercel.app does not apply on www): none is captured, every legacy URL reaches its intended rule, no source duplicates an existing one, and no destination is itself redirected. Archived titles come from the archived page <title>, else link text on archived listing pages/feeds, else the slug. Vercel serves permanent:true as 308, which Google treats like 301.
